# Meshopt decoder

Unmodified official production ES module and license from the MIT-licensed
[meshoptimizer 1.1.1 npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/meshoptimizer/v/1.1.1).
Only the decoder is vendored. The embedded WebAssembly requires no remote
fetch, and the viewer imports it only for catalogs marked Meshopt.
